system.description: You can slowly pass through physical barriers of level 5 or lower at a rate of 1 foot (30 cm) per round (minimum of one Last action to pass through any barrier). You can perceive while phased within a barrier or object, which could allow you to peek through walls. You can't use this ability to pass through energy barriers. Effort: Increase the maximum level of the barrier you can pass through by 1. Last action.
